sources.snippet: LTX-2.5The world model the world builds on. Lightricks' open-weights audio-video model, live on fal. Diffusion Fidelity Rendering puts more compute into complex scenes, native multishot holds a scene together across cuts, and synchronized audio comes built in. Open and customizable: train LoRAs, fine-tune on your own data, and adapt it to your domain. Try LTX-2.5 on fal.ai.
